rules.name: Three-way match

chapters.title: About this document
chapters.body: Confirmed automation framework generated from reviewed conversations.

body.summary: Automate the confirmed standard Invoice match case while exceptions remain human-controlled.

body.problem: Analysts manually compare invoices, purchase orders, and goods receipts.

body.currentState: Invoices arrive in a shared mailbox and exceptions are identified late.

body.step: Receive invoice from the shared mailbox as the read-only source.
Extract supplier, amounts, purchase-order and line-item fields.
Match invoice, purchase-order and goods-receipt records by hand.

body.included: Measure automatic handling rate and exception cycle time.

chapters.title: The solution and the to-be process

body.solution: Read invoice and ERP data, apply confirmed matching rules, and queue exceptions for human review.

body.targetState: Standard matches are prepared automatically; people decide exception cases.

body.step: Route unmatched or low-confidence cases to a reasoned exception queue.
Post clean matches in ERP while humans keep approval control.
